name: pick-object
title: Pick an object
signature: pick(object: object_ref, hands: hand?, grasp: tag?, pass_by: pose2d?)
description: Grasp one object with the right gripper and lift it. The grasp is chosen automatically from the object and where it is: from inside a microwave, slide-to-edge + edge pinch for flat items, handle pinch, rectangular or round rim pinch, top pinch, or a two-handed lift for wide items.
use_when: The robot must hold an object for any later hand action.

not_to_be_confused_with.regrasp: regrasp improves a grasp on an object that is already held.
not_to_be_confused_with.uncover: uncover lifts a lid off its container and keeps it.

hands.description: "both" requests a two-handed lift for wide items.

grasp.description: Optional grasp style to request: handle, rim, top or edge.

pass_by.description: Optional base waypoint: grasp while driving past.

applicability.summary: Requires hand_empty(hand=right); base_near(place=$object). Some bound nouns add preconditions (see Conditions that depend on the bound nouns).

preconditions.meaning: Base centre within 1.3 m of the place's footprint (inside the room for a room).

postconditions.meaning: The object is in the given gripper: fingers not shut, TCP-to-body distance unchanged since the grasp.

preconditions.meaning: Joint at least 60 % of the way from closed to its annotated open value.
Joint at least 60 % of the way from closed to its annotated open value.
Some annotated pinch of the object has both finger slots (2.8 x 1.2 cm, at the pre-grasp opening) free of neighbours; objects without a pinch need 3.5 cm of free footprint gap.

postconditions.meaning: The object is in the given gripper: fingers not shut, TCP-to-body distance unchanged since the grasp.
The object is in the given gripper: fingers not shut, TCP-to-body distance unchanged since the grasp.

preconditions.meaning: Some annotated pinch of the object has both finger slots (2.8 x 1.2 cm, at the pre-grasp opening) free of neighbours; objects without a pinch need 3.5 cm of free footprint gap.
Some annotated pinch of the object has both finger slots (2.8 x 1.2 cm, at the pre-grasp opening) free of neighbours; objects without a pinch need 3.5 cm of free footprint gap.

failure.on_failure: stop and report the measured pre/postconditions; nothing is retried.
typical: no reachable grasp from any base pose
no free support edge for a flat object

includes: grasp route selection from GT annotation
base re-park for the chosen grasp
approach, close, lift, measured hold check

arg_formats.pose2d: a base pose [x, y, yaw_deg] in metres and degrees
arg_formats.tag: an asset tag or asset name, e.g. "fruit", "toy", "cherry_tomato"

returns.success: true when every precondition held, the action ran and every postcondition holds
returns.error_code: on failure: INPUT_MISSING, INPUT_UNKNOWN, PRECONDITION_FAILED, NO_PATH, POLICY_FAILED, SUBSKILL_FAILED or POSTCONDITION_FAILED
returns.preconditions: each precondition as evaluated before moving, with holds = true/false
returns.postconditions: each postcondition as evaluated after the action, with holds = true/false
returns.outputs: the measured values listed under Outputs
